en: Clear the production dependency audit again: raise `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` to 1.32.1 and `undici` to 7.30.1, resolve patched `proxy-addr`, `fast-uri` and `ip-address` releases, and replace `fast-glob` with `tinyglobby` and `gray-matter` with the existing `yaml` parser. Visible effects: MCP connections no longer follow a redirect to another host or from https to plain http (an http to https upgrade on the same host still works), and a redirect to another host now fails as a configuration error instead of being retried; Glob skips unreadable directories and files that disappear during the search instead of failing, prunes directories that match an ignore pattern, and drops a leading `./` from paths, while `include_directories` no longer lists symlinks and lists `dir` itself for `dir/**`; @-mentioned globs attach the first 30 files in sorted order; memory files are read as plain-string front matter (a BOM and trailing spaces on `---` lines are accepted, an unterminated front-matter block is rejected).
zh-CN: 重新清空生产依赖审计：将 `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 升至 1.32.1、`undici` 升至 7.30.1，解析到已修补的 `proxy-addr`、`fast-uri` 和 `ip-address` 版本，并用 `tinyglobby` 替换 `fast-glob`、用已有的 `yaml` 解析器替换 `gray-matter`。可见的变化：MCP 连接不再跟随指向其他主机、或从 https 降到 http 的重定向（同一主机从 http 升到 https 仍然可以），重定向到其他主机现在作为配置错误报告，不再重试；Glob 遇到不可读的目录或搜索过程中消失的文件时跳过，不再整体失败，会剪掉匹配忽略规则的目录，并去掉路径开头的 `./`；`include_directories` 不再列出符号链接，`dir/**` 也会列出 `dir` 本身；@ 提及的 glob 按排序后的前 30 个文件附加；记忆文件的 front matter 一律按字符串读取（接受 BOM 和 `---` 行尾空白，未闭合的 front matter 会被拒绝）。
